sourcePackage.title: Generic x86_64 (64-bit)
sourcePackage.description: This board support package (BSP) is for generic x86_64 (64-bit) boards. This BSP contains prebuilt binaries and buildfiles to boot your board with the QNX Muon RTOS. In addition, this BSP provides source code for various drivers that you can build. For documentation to use this BSP, download the user's guide.
